header.running_head: Kissing the Body of Rasulullaah ﷺ

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Yazeed bin Abdullaah bin Qusayt
blocks.text: Another narration from Hadhrat Yazeed bin Abdullaah bin Qusayt states that when the Masjid (Nabawi) was empty he saw several Sahabah (RA) use their right hands to pick up some of the shiny and smooth sand from that side of the pulpit which adjoined Rasulullaah ﷺ's grave. They then made du'aa facing the Qibla.
Kissing the Body of Rasulullaah ﷺ
The Incident of Hadhrat Usayd bin Hudhayr (RA)

Hadhrat Abu Layla (RA) says that Hadhrat Usayd bin Hudhayr (RA) was a good man who was always smiling and jovial. One day as he was busy speaking to some people in the presence of Rasulullaah ﷺ and making them laugh, Rasulullaah ﷺ poked his side. "You've hurt me," he complained. "Then take your revenge," replied Rasulullaah ﷺ. Hadhrat Usayd (RA) remarked, "But you have a garment on while I do not." Rasulullaah ﷺ raised his upper garment and Hadhrat Usayd (RA) immediately embraced Rasulullaah ﷺ and started kissing his sides. He said, "May my parents be sacrificed for you, O Rasulullaah ﷺ! This is all I wanted to do."[^1]
Hadhrat Sawaad bin Ghuzayyah (RA) Kisses Rasulullaah ﷺ's Belly

Hadhrat Habbaan bin Waasi reports from senior scholars from his tribe that Rasulullaah ﷺ had the shaft of an arrow in his hand during the Battle of Badr as he was straightening the rows of the Sahabah (RA). Hadhrat Sawaad bin Ghuzayyah (RA) who was an ally of the Banu Adi bin Najjaar tribe was standing ahead of the row. As Rasulullaah ﷺ passed by him, Rasulullaah ﷺ nudged the shaft in his belly saying, "Get in line, O Sawaad." Hadhrat Sawaad (RA) said, "You have hurt me, O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Allaah has sent you with the truth and with justice, so allow me to have retribution." Rasulullaah ﷺ uncovered his belly and said, "You may have your retribution." Hadhrat Sawaad (RA) then embraced and started kissing Rasulullaah ﷺ's belly. "What makes you do this, O Sawaad?" asked Rasulullaah ﷺ. You can see what developments are (that a battle is looming), so I wish that my last meeting with you (if I am killed) should be with my skin touching yours." Rasulullaah ﷺ then made du'aa for him.[^2]
